Nora (CSM): Quick flag 1 NorthEdge showing a 60% drop in interactive assistant calls since Tuesday. New procurement lead (Daniel) started last week and is running a side-by-side.
health-bot: [signal] account=NorthEdge drop=60% category=usage
Evan (AE): Any infra or billing errors?
Nora (CSM): None. Looks like they disabled a nightly ingestion job and attendance at enablement demos dropped.
Daniel (Client): Correct 5. We're pausing a few pipelines while we compare against RivetAI. Procurement requested a 7-10 day apples-to-apples test with steady-state runs and a short compliance note.
Priyanka (Solutions): Recommend a Dedicated trial with a pre-warm script, steady 50rps run, and cost breakdown with batching/cache impact. I'll draft the config and test harness.
Evan (AE): Let's schedule a 30m alignment call to lock scope. Daniel, are mornings or afternoons PT better?
Daniel (Client): Afternoons PT work. Also please include a one-pager showing how caching changes unit costs.
Nora (CSM): Playbook: Evan -> book call (owner Evan). Priyanka -> trial config + perf plan (owner Priyanka). Nora -> enablement drop-in + compliance blurb (owner Nora). Deadline: materials to Daniel by Wed EOD. Renewal status: elevated until trial completes.
Evan (AE): Invite sent for Thu 2:30pm PT.
Priyanka (Solutions): Uploaded draft perf plan and warmup script to thread.
Nora (CSM): Thanks 5. I'll bundle everything and follow up after the call to update risk status.
